title: Elux Firerose 5000 Orange Zest 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elux Firerose 5000 Orange Zest Nic Salt captures the bold citrus bite of zesty Orange with a beguiling, bittersweet depth. This flavour leans into the sharper side of the fruit, evoking the bright tang of fresh Orange peel balanced with just enough sweetness to keep it punchy but smooth. It’s a vibrant and distinctive profile that citrus flavour fans will adore for its clarity and character. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Orange Zest Nic Salt provides rich flavour, a tactile yet comfortable throat hit and discreet vapour production. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this e-liquid works brilliantly in pod kits, vape pens and other low-powered devices. Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salts offer a convenient way to enjoy well-known Elux flavours, and thrilling new profiles, using refillable vape kits, delivering satisfaction, value, and performance in every 10ml bottle.
